test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states of India has topped the medal tally in the 4th Khelo India Youth Games to be held in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Haryana -**

 
 
• Haryana is a state in northern India.
 
• It is the eighteenth-largest state by area and the seventeenth-most populous state in India.
 
• **It has hosted the Khelo India Youth Games once - in 2020. In the last edition, it finished at the top position with 68 gold medals.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uttar Pradesh - **

 
 
• Uttar Pradesh is a state in northern India.
 
• It is the most populous state in India and the fourth-largest state by area.
 
• It has hosted the Khelo India Youth Games twice - in 2018 and 2020. In the last edition, it finished at the second position with 38 gold medals. 
 
 
 
• **Karnataka - **
 
 
• Karnataka is a state in the southwestern region of India.
 
• It is the sixth-largest state by area and the eighth-most populous state in India.
 
• It has not hosted the Khelo India Youth Games yet. In the last edition, it finished at the sixth position with 10 gold medals.
 
 
 
• **Kerala - **
 
 
• Kerala is a state on the southwestern coast of India.
 
• It is the thirteenth-largest state by area and the twelfth-most populous state in India.
 
• It has hosted the Khelo India Youth Games once - in 2019.
 
• In the last edition, it finished at the seventh position with 9 gold medals.
